Uniform fixed half/half sample factor B reaches 1/(T+1), hence strict adaptive disadvantage at T≥4 and limiting 1/9 plateau; contraction iff β∈(0,2/T). value.rationale: PASS: The sharp concurrency=3 switch and nonzero best worst-batch plateau expose a genuine sample-collision mechanism where adaptive squared-residual importance sampling is provably worse than uniform sampling from T=4 onward. The exact motivated two-row benchmark is a useful stress test for parallel adaptive solvers; no general runtime theorem or large-system result is needed for this focused boundary.
